title: O God, Do Not Keep Silence

questions.question: O God, do not keep silence; do not hold your peace or be still, O what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:1 (ESV): "O God, do not keep silence; do not hold your peace or be still, O God!"

questions.question: For behold, your enemies make an uproar; those who hate you have raised their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:2 (ESV): "For behold, your enemies make an uproar; those who hate you have raised their heads."

questions.question: They lay crafty plans against your people; they consult together against your what ones?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:3 (ESV): "...they consult together against your treasured ones."

questions.question: They say, "Come, let us wipe them out as a nation; let the name of Israel be remembered no what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:4 (ESV): "...let the name of Israel be remembered no more!"

questions.question: For they conspire with one accord; against you they make a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:5 (ESV): "For they conspire with one accord; against you they make a covenant—"

questions.question: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:6 (ESV): "the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,"

questions.question: Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, Philistia with the inhabitants of where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:7 (ESV): "Gebal and Ammon and Amalek, Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;"

questions.question: Asshur also has joined them; they are the strong arm of the children of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:8 (ESV): "Asshur also has joined them; they are the strong arm of the children of Lot."

questions.question: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the river what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:9 (ESV): "Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,"

questions.question: Who were destroyed at En-dor, who became dung for the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:10 (ESV): "...who became dung for the ground."

questions.question: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:11 (ESV): "...all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,"

questions.question: Who said, "Let us take possession for ourselves of the pastures of whom?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:12 (ESV): "who said, 'Let us take possession for ourselves of the pastures of God.'"

questions.question: O my God, make them like whirling dust, like chaff before the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:13 (ESV): "O my God, make them like whirling dust, like chaff before the wind."

questions.question: As fire consumes the forest, as the flame sets the mountains on what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:14 (ESV): "As fire consumes the forest, as the flame sets the mountains ablaze,"

questions.question: That they may know that you alone, whose name is the Lord, are the Most High over all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 83:18 (ESV): "that they may know that you alone, whose name is the Lord, are the Most High over all the earth."

key_verse_text: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the Lord, are the Most High over all the earth.
